slideAllocationStrategy.overviewSlide: If objectives or multiple themes present (1 slide)

slideAllocationStrategy.insightSlides: Synthesize key insights and recommendations (1-2 slides)
slideAllocationStrategy.conclusionSlide: Always include with key takeaways (1 slide)

dataMappingStrategy.insights: Map to insight slides with supporting data points
